integrity_notes.proof_type: analytic uniform Fourier-alias estimates and convexity; standalone finite checks are supplementary

scientific_limitations: Fixed rectangular Gabor lattice (translation step one, modulation step one-half), integral-one unscaled cardinal B-splines, and increasing spline order. Sharp frame constants do not transfer to arbitrary lattices or Gaussian-scaled windows; no exact finite-order global optimizer is claimed.
title: Sharp high-order half-density Gabor conditioning for unscaled cardinal B-splines
